question: Who among the following started the newspaper, 'Sambad Kaumudi'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Raja Ram Mohan Roy**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy was a prominent Indian social reformer and the founder of the Brahmo Samaj.
 
• He is often regarded as the "Father of the Indian Renaissance" for his efforts to abolish the practices of sati and child marriage.
 
• Raja Ram Mohan Roy started the newspaper 'Sambad Kaumudi' in 1821 to promote social reforms and spread political awareness.
